prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic golden-hour Paris fashion detail portrait of an approved adult woman near the Eiffel Tower.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman shown from waist to feet in a white short skirt, blue patterned jacket, and blue pointed heels, standing elegantly on a stone terrace with one leg naturally bent. Keep the focus on fashion styling and composition rather than body emphasis.
prompt.composition_elements: Extreme low-angle vertical framing with the Eiffel Tower glowing in the background, stone balustrade, Paris avenue depth, and warm sunset sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Photorealistic golden-hour light, warm highlights, soft shadows, cinematic elegant Paris mood, realistic skin, fabric, stone, and skyline texture.
prompt.technical_specs: High-detail vertical fashion photography, low-angle perspective, sharp clothing and footwear, natural depth of field, realistic sunset exposure.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical golden-hour Paris fashion detail portrait of an approved adult woman shown from waist to feet near the Eiffel Tower. She wears a white short skirt, blue patterned jacket, and blue pointed heels, standing elegantly on a stone terrace with one leg naturally bent. Frame her from a respectful fashion-editorial angle with the Eiffel Tower glowing behind, stone balustrade, Paris avenue, and warm sunset sky. Emphasize styling, architecture, fabric movement, realistic textures, and cinematic elegance rather than body emphasis.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, voyeuristic angle, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra limbs, deformed feet, distorted tower
